slides.heading: FY26 REVENUE · ₹ CRORE · PRO FORMA, AS THE COMPANY GIVES IT
slides.body: Shalimar's own FY26 EBITDA: "Negative ₹18.5 crore". The merger still needs exchange, SEBI, NCLT and creditor approvals.

slides.heading: WHAT THE MERGED GROUP SELLS · SHARE OF FY26 REVENUE
slides.body: About 75% is B2B, delivered to project sites; about 25% goes through retail.

slides.heading: PRO FORMA EBITDA MARGIN
slides.body: The company credits own brands (33% → 69% of revenue), owned plants and faster retail growth.

slides.heading: FY26 · PRO FORMA · ₹ CRORE
slides.body: Profit is about 1.2% of revenue (our maths). The documents read don't split the gap into interest, depreciation, tax or minorities.

slides.heading: WHO OWNS THE MERGED COMPANY · AS THE COMPANY GIVES IT
slides.body: Based on 6 Nov 2026 holdings, before the 20 Nov QIP of about ₹400 crore.
